title: Tata 1mg raises fresh funding round from global investors
summary: Online pharmacy and healthcare platform Tata 1mg has closed a new funding round led by international investors, valuing the company higher than its previous round, as part of the Tata Digital ecosystem's push into healthcare. Tata 1mg is not separately listed on any stock exchange.

title: Infosys Q1 net profit rises 12% on strong deal wins
summary: IT major Infosys reported a 12% year-on-year rise in net profit for the June quarter, driven by robust growth in its digital and cloud services segments, and raised its full-year revenue guidance.

title: SEBI slaps penalty on Reliance Industries over disclosure lapses
summary: Market regulator SEBI has imposed a monetary penalty on Reliance Industries for delayed disclosure of a material event, citing violations of listing obligation norms.

title: Tata Steel to acquire majority stake in European steel unit
summary: Tata Steel announced plans to acquire a controlling stake in a mid-sized European steel manufacturer as part of its overseas expansion strategy, in a deal valued at several hundred million dollars.

title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged, cites balanced inflation outlook
summary: The Reserve Bank of India kept its key policy rate unchanged for the third consecutive meeting, with the central bank governor noting inflation remains within the comfort band. No specific listed company was named.
